_about: Online play (scripts/camp/camp.gd). Two players in total: the host plus one guest. spare_connections lets one more PC connect only to be told the camp is full. protocol must match on both PCs. Rates are per second. A link code moves a couch character to its own PC: link_code_letters leaves out look-alikes (0/O, 1/I/L, 5/S, 2/Z, 8/B).
